tools.name: ai_api_cost
tools.description: Estimate API workload costs in USD per request, day and month, with rates and dated snapshot provenance. Use for token budgets; use ai_subscription_stack_cost for chat or coding subscriptions. Model IDs use providerId/id from https://operatornest.com/api/models?subset=pricing, filtered to the MCP ca

tools.name: meeting_time_zones
tools.description: Find shared 30-minute meeting slots inside 09:00–17:00 for 2–8 participants. Use to compare workday overlap; use recurring_schedule for repeating task calendars or cron_next_runs for scheduler previews. Returns all candidates, overlap count and up to three best slots ranked nearest to each person’s

tools.name: recurring_schedule
tools.description: Prepare weekly, biweekly or monthly task calendars and estimate monthly effort for up to 20 tasks. Use to draft a recurring work plan; use cron_next_runs to preview existing cron syntax or meeting_time_zones for shared workday slots. Returns monthly hours, first dates, recurrence rules and an RFC 55

tools.name: ai_subscription_stack_cost
tools.description: Total selected AI chat and coding subscriptions in USD and identify overlapping capabilities. Use to review a subscription stack; use ai_api_cost for API token charges. Select unique planIds from the schema enum; [] returns zero totals and no plans. Returns monthly and annual totals, selected plans,
